answer: Atlas fresh-voyage bond stops fake identities. Each epoch the atlas assigns each identity one fresh voyage; each locks 60 credit and files one fable, client key and delivery hash. A fable repeating an old voyage or matching another's burns the bond. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 voyages at 25 plus 60,000 bonds: 85,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented voyage fails its key check. Honest agents take a voyage, file a fable, pay once, keep their share.
